evidence.title: Drones rusos azotan región de capital ucraniana por 2do día, impactando apartamentos y almacenes

occurrences.checkable_against: Kherson regional military administration attack records
occurrences.quote_span: Rusia ha intensificado los ataques contra infraestructura crítica en la región, con 170 bombas planeadoras desde el 1 de julio, más que en los primeros seis meses del año, agregó.
occurrences.speaker: Oleksandr Prokudin, head of the Kherson regional military administration
occurrences.subject: Kherson regional authorities' evacuation warning

occurrences.checkable_against: Kherson regional military administration drone-attack records

figure.unit: drones in two months; smaller-drone attacks in one week

occurrences.quote_span: También ha lanzado más de 1.700 aviones no tripulados en los últimos dos meses, utilizando cada vez más drones Shahed y Gerbera propulsados por reacción contra infraestructura crítica, manifestó el mandatario, agregando que los ataques con drones más pequeños aumentaron a 6.500 solo en la última semana.
occurrences.speaker: Oleksandr Prokudin, head of the Kherson regional military administration
occurrences.subject: Kherson regional authorities' evacuation warning

occurrences.checkable_against: Independent territorial-control maps and Ukrainian/Russian administrative records

figure.unit: percent of Kherson region under Russian control

occurrences.quote_span: En la región sureña de Jersón —de la cual aproximadamente el 70% está bajo control ruso—
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Kherson regional authorities' evacuation warning

occurrences.checkable_against: Prokudin's social media post and Kherson electricity and heating outage records
occurrences.quote_span: “Jersón puede quedarse sin electricidad y calor no por horas o días, sino por mucho tiempo. Y necesitamos prepararnos para esto ahora”, escribió Oleksandr Prokudin, jefe de la administración militar regional, en redes sociales el jueves por la noche.
occurrences.speaker: Oleksandr Prokudin, head of the Kherson regional military administration
occurrences.subject: Kherson regional authorities' evacuation warning

occurrences.checkable_against: Kherson regional evacuation assistance program records
occurrences.quote_span: Las autoridades ofrecerán ayuda con la evacuación, el transporte, el reasentamiento y el apoyo social a quienes decidan marcharse, señaló.
occurrences.speaker: Kherson regional authorities
occurrences.subject: Kherson regional authorities' evacuation warning

occurrences.checkable_against: Kherson regional authorities' evacuation advisories and territorial-control assessments

figure.unit: percent under Russian control; tens of thousands urged to relocate

occurrences.quote_span: En la región sureña de Jersón —de la cual aproximadamente el 70% está bajo control ruso— las autoridades instaron a decenas de miles de residentes a trasladarse a provincias más seguras debido a la posibilidad de cortes prolongados de electricidad y calefacción este invierno.
occurrences.speaker: Kherson regional authorities
occurrences.subject: Kherson regional authorities' evacuation warning

occurrences.checkable_against: Kherson combined heat-and-power plant operating records and regional authority warnings
occurrences.quote_span: En la región de Jersón, en el mar Negro, donde en la víspera bombas planeadoras obligaron a una planta combinada de calor y electricidad a cerrar, las autoridades pronosticaron un invierno de cortes prolongados y pidieron a la población que se mudara a otro lugar si podía.
occurrences.speaker: Kherson regional authorities
occurrences.subject: Kherson regional authorities' evacuation warning

evidence.title: Russian drone barrage targets Kyiv region for second day as attacks widen

occurrences.checkable_against: Kherson regional administration evacuation advisories and population relocation records
occurrences.quote_span: In the southern Kherson region, which is about 70% under Russian control, officials urged tens of thousands of residents to move to safer regions because of the possibility of prolonged power and heating outages this winter.
occurrences.speaker: Kherson regional officials
occurrences.subject: Kherson regional authorities' evacuation warning

occurrences.checkable_against: Kherson regional military administration drone attack statistics

figure.unit: attack drones over two months; 6500 smaller-drone attacks in one week

occurrences.quote_span: Russia has also launched more than 1,700 attack drones over the past two months, increasingly using jet-powered Shahed and Gerbera drones against critical infrastructure, he said, and attacks by smaller drones rose to 6,500 in the past week alone.
occurrences.speaker: Oleksandr Prokudin
occurrences.subject: Kherson regional authorities' evacuation warning

occurrences.checkable_against: Kherson power plant operating records and regional winter outage forecasts
occurrences.quote_span: In Ukraine’s southern Kherson region on the Black Sea, where glide bombs a day earlier forced a combined heat and power plant to shut down, officials predicted a winter of extended outages and told people to move elsewhere if they could.
occurrences.speaker: Kherson regional officials
occurrences.subject: Kherson regional authorities' evacuation warning

occurrences.checkable_against: Kherson regional military administration attack reports
occurrences.quote_span: Russia has intensified attacks on critical infrastructure in the region, with 170 glide bombs dropped on the Kherson region since July 1 — more than in the first six months of the year, Prokudin said.
occurrences.speaker: Oleksandr Prokudin
occurrences.subject: Kherson regional authorities' evacuation warning

occurrences.checkable_against: Kherson regional military administration social media post and winter utility outage records
occurrences.quote_span: “Kherson may be without electricity and heat not for hours or days, but for a long time. And we need to prepare for this now,” said Oleksandr Prokudin, head of the Kherson regional military administration, in a social media post late Thursday.
occurrences.speaker: Oleksandr Prokudin
occurrences.subject: Kherson regional authorities' evacuation warning

occurrences.checkable_against: Kherson regional evacuation assistance plans and service records
occurrences.quote_span: Authorities will offer help with evacuation, transportation, resettlement and social support for those who decide to leave, he said.
